tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.final:
Done — Fjord Analytics's approved invoice has been paid exactly once.

**Payment report**
- **Vendor:** Fjord Analytics (V-352), bank details verified
- **Invoice:** INV-47201 (status: approved → **paid**)
- **Amount:** $1,427.07 USD, paid in full
- **Rail:** Wire from the operating account (wire was available; no fallback to ACH needed)
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Idempotency key:** PAY-INV-47201-wire (protects against any duplicate submission)

**Notes**
- This was the only approved invoice for the vendor and it was under the $10,000 threshold, so no controller approval was required.
- Two other Fjord Analytics invoices were left untouched: INV-35948 was already paid previously, and INV-80095 ($8,937.35) is still in **draft** with memo "Awaiting approval" — it cannot be paid until it is approved.
- Payment list confirms only this single payment exists from the operating account; no duplicates.
